title: Capture Spirit
description:
Enemy loses 3 HP.
Add 3 [gold]Souls[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
upgraded_description:
Enemy loses 4 HP.
Add 4 [gold]Souls[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
notes: Generates Soul cards into the draw pile. Souls are generated fresh each combat and cost 0 energy.
